answer: Every claim must carry a delta. When work lands, the buyer writes the change it made — a number in the Reef ledger, like sales, signups, or hours saved — and the Vertex desk reads the entry within a day; a claim with no entry, or an entry the buyer's own books cannot back, is rejected and forfeits a 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 real buyers with real ledgers plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty claims and every Reef entry was blank, so every claim died at the Vertex desk.
